title: 第13章 梦境第14章 绝境逢生
lines: 单河田似乎察觉到李骏的心思，他的脸忽然开始扭曲，那嘲笑的笑容逐渐变得怪异，皮肤仿佛被拉伸开来，变形得可怕。
紧接着，他的脸上竟然长出了黑色的毒刺，整个人慢慢化为一只巨大的毒蝎！
李骏的心脏仿佛被什么狠狠捏住，狂跳不止。
他转头看向周围，惊恐地发现其他学子的脸庞也在迅速扭曲变形。
“苏帅！
“啊，邓盟，你别过来！”
一个个学子竟然全部变成了毒蝎，锋利的毒针和爪子在阳光下闪闪发光。
“夫子，救我！
夫子！”
李骏慌乱地伸手去抓丁夫子的手臂，试图找到一丝安全感。
可是，丁夫子的手臂却湿漉漉的，冰冷而恶心。
李骏猛然抬头，发现丁夫子脸上的鄙夷逐渐变成了一张恐怖的鬼脸，满脸黑血不断渗出，眼睛死死盯着李骏，仿佛想将他撕成碎片。
李骏猛然嘶吼一声，学堂瞬间天翻地覆，四周的一切如同幻境般破碎崩塌，眼前变成了一片荒芜的土地，周围是无尽的黑暗，令人窒息的绝望感笼罩了他。
“啰嗖嗖！”
几只巨大的毒竭突然窜了出来，张牙舞爪地向李骏逼近，它们的毒针闪着寒光，仿佛随时要刺穿李骏的身体。
“快跑！”
李骏的身体在极度的恐惧下反应了过来，他拔腿就跑，拼命地逃离毒蝎的追击。
然而，那些毒蝎的速度越来越快，咯吱咯吱的爪子声在他身后越来越近。
他继续跑着，根本不敢回头看去。
在他的头顶，突然出现了丁夫子的鬼面，那鬼脸变得巨大如云朵般，遮天蔽日，紧紧跟随在李骏身后，发出尖锐刺耳的笑声。
“桀桀桀！”
鬼面嘶吼着，狞笑着，血盆大口张开，朝李骏猛然一吸，巨大的吸力仿佛要把李骏的灵魂从体内扯出来。
李骏看到自己的身体开始变得虚弱透明，手掌越来越轻盈，仿佛灵魂正一点点被鬼面吞噬。
他心中隐隐生出一丝希望。
“这一定是个梦，一定是梦！”
他内心不断祈祷，恨不得赶紧醒来，回到荷叶塘的田地里，继续他的日常生活，哪怕是干最累的农活，也比面对这些诡异的事要好。
然而，现实并未如他所愿。
就在他祈祷的瞬间，头顶悬浮的巨大而狰狞的鬼面，变得更加凝实和强大，它如同幽灵般飘荡而出，带着猎杀的本能，呼啸着冲向李骏。
那鬼面所带来的贪婪与恶意如同实质，扑面而来，令李骏浑身发抖，汗毛竖起，心跳几乎停滞。
就在鬼面即将逼近的刹那，一道耀眼的银光突然从天而降，瞬间击中了鬼面，直接将鬼面击溃。
鬼面在半空中化为片片血雾，飘散开来。
然而，诡异的是，这些血雾并没有消散，而是再次凝结起来，化作更凶狠的鬼面，再次向李骏袭来。
疲惫的李骏，已经在鬼面的威压下，意识溃散，肢体瘫软在地。
鬼面要再次靠近时，数道银光同时从四面八方闪现，犹如一道道锋利的刀刃，再次将鬼面刺穿，将它撕碎。
此时，空中忽然浮现出一个巨大的银色松果。
鬼面再次复原，但是那松果碾压在鬼面之上。
鬼面发出一声惨叫，被松果碾压得扭曲变形，随后鬼面破碎，被松果释放的银光绞杀得干干净净。
这次，鬼面彻底被绞杀成了粉末，无法再凝聚，连最后一丝怨念都被消散在空气中。
松果缓缓落地，此时的李骏趴在地上，已经失去了意识，身体虚弱，动弹不得。
松果微鸣，释放出一种奇异的力量。
那被鬼面吞噬的灵光开始在四周凝聚，重新回到了李骏体内。
他原本几乎透明的身体，慢慢开始变得凝实，灵魂也逐渐恢复了力量。
content_en:
Shan Hetian seemed to be aware of Li Jun's thoughts. His face suddenly began to distort, and the mocking smile gradually became weird. His skin seemed to be stretched and deformed horribly.
Immediately afterwards, black poisonous stingers sprouted from his face, and his whole body slowly turned into a huge poisonous scorpion!
Li Jun's heart seemed to be pinched hard by something, and it was beating wildly.
He turned to look around and was horrified to find that the faces of other students were also rapidly distorting.
"Su Shuai!
You..."
"Ah, Deng Meng, don't come over here!"
One by one, the students turned into poisonous scorpions, their sharp poisonous needles and claws shining in the sun.
"Master, save me!
Master! "
Li Jun panicked and reached out to grab Master Ding's arm, trying to find a sense of security.
However, Master Ding's arms were wet, cold and disgusting.
Li Jun suddenly raised his head and found that the contempt on Master Ding's face gradually turned into a terrifying grimace, with black blood oozing out from his face, and his eyes were staring at Li Jun, as if he wanted to tear him into pieces.
"Ah!"
Li Jun roared suddenly, and the school was turned upside down in an instant. Everything around him shattered and collapsed like an illusion. His eyes turned into a barren land, surrounded by endless darkness, and a suffocating sense of despair enveloped him.
"Whoosh whoosh!"
Several huge poisonous needles suddenly sprang out and approached Li Jun with their fangs and claws. Their poisonous needles shone with cold light, as if they were about to pierce Li Jun's body at any time.
"Run!"
Li Jun's body reacted in extreme fear, and he ran away, desperately escaping from the poisonous scorpion's pursuit.
However, the speed of those poisonous scorpions was getting faster and faster, and the sound of creaking claws was getting closer and closer behind him.
He continued running, not daring to look back.
Above his head, Master Ding's ghostly face suddenly appeared. The ghostly face became as huge as a cloud, covering the sky and the sun. It followed closely behind Li Jun, making a sharp and harsh laugh.
"Jie Jie Jie!"
The ghost face roared, grinned ferociously, opened its bloody mouth, and sucked suddenly at Li Jun. The huge suction force seemed to pull Li Jun's soul out of his body.
Li Jun saw that his body began to become weak and transparent, and his hands became lighter and lighter, as if his soul was being swallowed bit by bit by the ghost face.
There was a glimmer of hope in his heart.
"This must be a dream, it must be a dream!"
He kept praying in his heart, wishing he could wake up quickly, return to the fields in the lotus pond, and continue his daily life. Even doing the most tiring farm work was better than facing these weird things.
However, reality did not go as he wished.
At the moment he was praying, the huge and ferocious ghost face suspended above his head became more solid and powerful. It floated out like a ghost, roaring towards Li Jun with a hunting instinct.
The greed and malice brought by the ghost face were like real substance, rushing towards his face, making Li Jun tremble all over, his hairs stood up, and his heartbeat almost stopped.
Just when the ghost face was about to approach, a dazzling silver light suddenly fell from the sky, instantly hitting the ghost face and directly defeating the ghost face.
The ghost face turned into pieces of blood mist in mid-air and dispersed.
However, the strange thing is that the blood mist did not dissipate, but condensed again, turning into a more ferocious ghost face, and attacked Li Jun again.
The tired Li Jun, already under the pressure of the ghost face, his consciousness collapsed and his limbs collapsed to the ground.
When the ghost face was about to approach again, several rays of silver light flashed from all directions at the same time, like sharp blades, piercing the ghost face again and tearing it into pieces.
At this time, a huge silver pine cone suddenly appeared in the sky.
The ghost face recovered again, but the pine cone crushed it.
The ghost face let out a scream and was crushed and twisted by the pine cone. Then the ghost face shattered and was strangled cleanly by the silver light released by the pine cone.
This time, Ghost Face was completely strangled into powder and could no longer be condensed. Even the last trace of resentment was dissipated in the air.
The pine cone slowly fell to the ground. At this time, Li Jun was lying on the ground, unconscious, weak and unable to move.
The pine cones chirped slightly, releasing a strange power.
The spiritual light swallowed by the ghost face began to condense around him and returned to Li Jun's body.
His originally almost transparent body slowly began to solidify, and his soul gradually regained its strength.
title_en: Chapter 13 Dream Chapter 14 Survival from desperate situation
